Kerala.fact: == History == === Legend === In stories of the Dashavatara from Hindu mythology, the lands of Kerala were recovered from the sea by the axe-wielding warrior sage Parashurama, the sixth avatar (incarnation) of Vishnu.  As a result, Kerala is traditionally referred to as Parashurama Kshetram ("The Land of Parashurama").  According to legend, Parashurama threw his axe across the sea, and the water receded to the point where it landed.  This land that emerged extended from Gokarna to Kanyakumari.  The land that emerged was saline and uninhabitable, so Parashurama invoked the snake king Vasuki, who spat holy poison to purify the soil, transforming it into fertile land.
